input.quote: If either party materially breaches any term or condition of this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within-thirty (30) days after receiving written notice of the breach, the nonbreaching party may terminate this Agreement on written notice at any time following the end of such-thirty (30) day period.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee or minimum/shortfall payment obligation on our side. Fees payable by Corio (Sections 4.1–4.2 and Exhibit B/Payment Terms) are ordinary license, maintenance and revenue-share amounts, and Section 11 permits termination on breach or non-renewal with no termination charge or accelerated fee; Section 11.3 only continues fees for continuing use/support that we elect to receive. There is likewise no late-payment interest or penalty provision. The audit true-up in Section 4.2 (payment of a shortfall plus audit costs on a >5% underpayment) is a cost-recovery mechanic, not a liquidated damages or penalty amount. This meets the preferred position of no liquidated damages or penalties payable by the Customer, so no redline is proposed.
